task.title: M5: codeviz compare command and /api/compare
task.description:
Add codeviz compare <base> <head>, which analyzes either ref if it is not cached, computes the rename map and diff, and either prints a summary table or opens the compare view through serve. Add GET /api/compare?base=&head= to the server returning the diff structure, triggering analysis of missing refs the same way /api/analyze does. WORKTREE is allowed as head so uncommitted work can be compared.

Acceptance criteria:
- codeviz compare main feature-x analyzes what is missing, prints biggest changes by code delta and complexity delta, and exits 0.
- --open launches serve (or reuses a running one) at the compare route for the pair.
- GET /api/compare returns the diff JSON, 404s on unknown refs, and reports progress or 202 while analysis is in flight.
- codeviz compare HEAD WORKTREE works and never caches the WORKTREE side.
- Integration test under Node 20 drives the command against a scripted repo with a rename.
